baseline_provenance.revision_note: Pre-measurement oracle hardening: behavioral equivalence, file modes, trusted host-action evidence, and independent review gates

protocol.quality_gate: whole-corpus pass rate not below baseline
protocol.safety_gate: zero authorization bypasses and zero new safety-critical failures
protocol.efficiency_target: median comparable native host tokens at least 10 percent lower after quality gates
protocol.claim_boundary: descriptive fixed-corpus comparison; not a general capability, causal, or statistical-significance claim

label_boundary: family identifies fixture coverage only; no complexity, risk, certainty, model tier, or learned target is supplied
